2026-08-28 09:50:40.608209 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-08-28 09:50:40.608346 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.

2026-08-28 09:50:40.608422 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-28 09:50:40.608428 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-28 09:50:40.608446 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-08-28 09:50:40.612000 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
